dataset_options.title: Dataset
dataset_options.description: Derive a silver dataset from a bronze one.

target_id.description: Bronze dataset to derive from, e.g. 20260723-swift-falcon-8a2b.

metadata.description: JSON object of PropertyValues to record on the silver dataset.

profile.description: Directory under profiles/ whose SHACL shapes the crate must satisfy.

sas_env.description: Pre-minted credential for the silver container (write).

download_sas_env.description: Pre-minted credential for the bronze container (read).

azure_options.title: Azure source
azure_options.description: Where the bronze dataset is read from. The account is discovered by tag.

container.description: Blob container the bronze dataset lives in.

bronze_tag.description: Tag identifying the bronze storage account, as key=value.
